messages:
Maria V: Quick async — SDKs / quickstarts check-in. What I did: pushed JS SDK quickstart draft and sample-app skeleton, opened PR #482 for docs + sample. Blockers: docs preview 404, mkdocs rendering error on one code block. Today: fix docs build + address PR review comments so we can get a green preview.

Kevin L: Looking. Can you paste the build log error?

Maria V: Sure — snippet from netlify build: ```Error: Unknown fenced code language 'bash'
    at RenderJS (mkdocs-plugin)
```

Olivia R: I left inline comments on #482 re: method names in the SDK (prefers `createClient` over `init`). Also I think the mkdocs plugin upgrade broke fenced code parsing.

doc-bot: Preview for PR #482 is currently unavailable (404). Last deploy attempt failed. CI log: mdx-lint error 'no-html' at quickstarts/getting-started.md:34

Samir: I'll take the mkdocs plugin upgrade + test. Plan: pin plugin, add regression test for fenced codeblocks, open PR later today. Also added a tiny e2e for sample-app login flow in #489.

Kevin L: Cool. I can review types and the JS sample later today, ping me when #489 is up. If anyone needs the sample app test harness: `yarn && yarn start` in `samples/js-quickstart`.

Maria V: Thanks — one more question: sample-app env var mismatch — README used `REDWOOD_TOKEN` but SDK expects `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. I propose standardize to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Objections?

Olivia R: +1 to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. clearer.

doc-bot: CI status: docs lint failed (mdx-lint no-html). Tests: 0 failing, 2 warnings.

Samir: Opened PR #489 to pin plugin + add tests, included fix to remove inline HTML in the quickstart. Also fixed the env var in README and updated sample-app env example.

Kevin L: Reviewing #489 now, will aim for EOD.

Maria V: Awesome — if #489 merges and CI passes, I'll merge #482 and re-run preview. Thanks y'all. :rocket:
